SELECT 'TSK_EDS_CCD_CBCEQCTDBP','EDS','EDS','CCD_CBCEQCTDBP','CCD',NULL,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime),CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime),NULL,'WEEKDAYS','SNAPSHOT';GO
